parameters.jsCode: const jobs=$('[D02] 展开Dify任务').all().filter(i=>i.json?.__empty!==true);return $input.all().map((item,index)=>{let job=jobs[index]?.json??{};try{const matched=$('[D02] 展开Dify任务').itemMatching(index);if(matched?.json?.record_key)job=matched.json}catch{}const response=item.json??{};const hasStatusCode=response.statusCode!==undefined||response.status_code!==undefined||response.error?.statusCode!==undefined;const statusCode=hasStatusCode?Number(response.statusCode??response.status_code??response.error?.statusCode):200;const body=response.body??response.data?.body??response;let documents=[];if(Array.isArray(body?.data))documents=body.data;else if(Array.isArray(body?.documents))documents=body.documents;else if(Array.isArray(body?.data?.documents))documents=body.data.documents;const states=documents.map(d=>String(d?.indexing_status??d?.status??'').toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);let indexingStatus='processing';let transportError=false;let errorMessage=null;const explicitRequestError=Boolean(response.error)||(hasStatusCode&&(statusCode<200||statusCode>=400));if(explicitRequestError){transportError=true;errorMessage=String(body?.message??body?.detail??response.error?.message??`Dify status HTTP ${statusCode||'unknown'}`).slice(0,1500)}else if(!states.length){transportError=true;errorMessage='Dify接口返回成功，但响应中没有识别到data[].indexing_status'}else if(states.some(s=>['error','failed','stopped'].includes(s))){indexingStatus='error';errorMessage=JSON.stringify(body).slice(0,1500)}else if(states.every(s=>s==='completed')){indexingStatus='completed'}return{json:{...job,indexing_status:indexingStatus,transport_error:transportError,error_message:errorMessage,raw_status_code:statusCode,raw_states:states,raw_document_count:documents.length},pairedItem:{item:index}}});

const jobs=$('[R02] 展开R2任务').all().filter(i=>i.json?.__empty!==true);function hv(headers,name){if(!headers||typeof headers!=='object')return null;const key=Object.keys(headers).find(k=>k.toLowerCase()===name);const value=key?headers[key]:null;return Array.isArray(value)?value[0]:value}return $input.all().map((item,index)=>{let job=jobs[index]?.json??{};try{const matched=$('[R02] 展开R2任务').itemMatching(index);if(matched?.json?.image_md5)job=matched.json}catch{}const response=item.json??{};const code=Number(response.statusCode??response.status_code??response.error?.statusCode??0);const headers=response.headers??response.response?.headers??{};const verifyStatus=code>=200&&code<400?'verified':code===404?'missing':'error';const length=Number(hv(headers,'content-length'));return{json:{...job,verify_status:verifyStatus,error:verifyStatus==='verified'?null:verifyStatus==='missing'?'R2 object returned HTTP 404':String(response.error?.message??response.message??`HTTP ${code||'unknown'}`).slice(0,1500),content_length:Number.isFinite(length)?length:null,content_type:hv(headers,'content-type')},pairedItem:{item:index}}});
